deals.comment: CJ O Shopping Co., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) acquired the remaining 5.21% stake in CJ Educations Corporation for KRW 1.7 billion in cash on April 30, 2014. CJ O Shopping acquired 1.5 million shares of CJ Educations Corporation at a price of KRW 1120 per share.

deals.target: CJ Hellovision Co., Ltd., N Screen Service tving Business
deals.comment: CJ E&M Corporation (KOSDAQ:A130960) agreed to acquire the N Screen Service tving business from CJ Hellovision Co., Ltd. (KOSE:A037560) for KRW 2.6 billion on November 2, 2015. As per amendment report, CJ E&M Corporation (KOSDAQ:A130960) agreed to acquire the N Screen Service tving business from CJ Hellovision Co., Ltd. (KOSE:A037560) for KRW 2.6 billion on November 2, 2015. Under the revised amendment, CJ E&M Corporation paid KRW 2.61 billion. The Board of Directors of CJ E&M Corporation resolved the transaction on November 2, 2015.

Jooyoung Song and Kyusung Choi acquired 51% stake in Highup Entertainment Co., Ltd. from CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) for approximately KRW 260 million on August 27, 2018. Under the transaction, Jooyoung Song and Kyusung Choi acquired 0.026 million shares at KRW 5,000 per share respectively.

Studio Dragon Corporation (KOSDAQ:A253450) agreed to acquire GTIST for KRW 25 billion on March 25, 2019. Studio Dragon Corporation will acquire 0.2 million. The transaction has been approved by the Board of Directors of Studio Dragon and is expected to be completed on April 8, 2019.

CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) agreed to acquire additional 8.818696% stake in Tving Co.,Ltd for KRW 79.582 billion on October 13, 2021. CJ ENM CO., Ltd. will acquire 0.18 million shares of Tving Co.,Ltd. After the transaction CJ ENM will own 67.61% stake comprising of 1.38 million shares. The transaction is expected to close on October 15, 2021.
